# IBM

> IBM delivers enterprise AI, hybrid cloud, and data management solutions that transform business operations through intelligent automation and responsible technology.

IBM is a global technology leader offering comprehensive software, infrastructure, and consulting services designed for enterprise transformation. The site showcases IBM's core platforms including watsonx for AI, Red Hat OpenShift for hybrid cloud, and specialized solutions for data management, security, and automation across hybrid environments.
